title: Flak 2.0
author: Scapaflow69
selftext:
Retro-style arcade air-battle.

Built with AI assistance in under 2 days.

Switch between long-range and effective close-range fire.

comments.author: Scapaflow69
comments.body: I made the game browser-compatible for instant play [https://scapaflow69.itch.io/flak](https://scapaflow69.itch.io/flak) for those who are interested. (with source code on Github).
